'''2020 MPC Matthew Harrison-Trainor DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2020 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Match Play Championship]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open HD Harrison-Trainor DS 2020 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
